en_new: Uncle would laugh to see us fight over a box with a dial.

en_old: Uncle Bogdan's safe. We waited for Ewa: an hour and three teas. Opened in front of everyone. Nobody sulked.
en_new: Uncle Bogdan's safe. Waited an hour for Ewa and drank three teas. Opened in front of everyone. No sulking.

en_old: Mrs Zosia said you don't drill. My husband couldn't stand drilling.
en_new: Mrs Zosia said you don't drill. My husband couldn't stand drilling.

en_old: I'll open it so no one can tell. It stays his desk.
en_new: I'll leave no marks. It'll still be his desk.
note: Jasny, delikatny ton w scenie żałoby.

en_old: Opera tickets. Nineteen eighty-seven.
en_new: Opera tickets. Nineteen eighty-seven.

en_old: He told me he'd lost them. He kept them.
en_new: He told me he'd lost them. He kept them.

en_old: Mrs Irena, sent by Mrs Zosia. The bureau is in her home; no marks left. Tickets inside. I didn't ask.
en_new: Mrs Irena, sent by Mrs Zosia. The bureau is in her home; no marks left. Tickets inside. I didn't ask.

en_old: You're the one who didn't open my door? I baked you a cake. For not opening it.
en_new: You're the locksmith who didn't open my door? I baked you a cake. For not opening it.

en_old: The key won't go in. The lock broke while I was out.
en_new: The key won't go in. The lock broke while I was out.

en_old: Mr Kazimierz, there's another name on the mailbox. And this wreath?
en_new: Mr Kazimierz, there's another name on the mailbox. And this wreath?

en_old: Who's there? I've lived here twelve years. I made that wreath myself.
en_new: Who's there? I've lived here twelve years. I made that wreath myself.

en_old: Oh, one floor up the key fits. You've fixed it.
en_new: Oh, the key fits one floor up. You've fixed it.

en_old: Mr Kazimierz after a name-day party. Wrong floor. I opened nothing and it still worked. Best job of the week.
en_new: Mr Kazimierz after a name-day party. Wrong floor. Opened nothing. Problem solved. Best job of the week.

en_old: I can't open this one. But I can help another way.
en_new: I can't open this one. But I can help another way.

en_old: First ask whose it is. Then look at the lock.
en_new: First ask whose it is. Then look at the lock.

en_old: One paper is a hint. Two is a conversation. A neighbour is certainty.
en_new: One document is a clue. Two tell a story. A neighbour can confirm.
note: Usunięcie kalki „is certainty” i nieuprawnionej absolutności.

en_old: Whoever pays to skip questions is paying for someone else's door.
en_new: Whoever pays to skip questions is paying for someone else's door.

en_old: Quote before work. No surprises on the bill.
en_new: Give a quote before the job. No surprises on the bill.
note: Naturalna fraza zamiast hasłowego „Quote before work”.

en_old: What I saw inside stays inside.
en_new: What I saw inside stays inside.
